strategy.summary: Six mutants survive in src/pricing.js because the tests skip the boundaries and some assert nothing. Two existing tests get exact assertions added (none of their current assertions are removed), and new cases pin the $50 shipping boundary, the $100 coupon boundary, a code other than SAVE20, and a total that includes shipping. Expected values come from the doc comments and the README: free shipping from $50, SAVE20 only over $100, total = discounted subtotal + shipping.
inScope: shippingCost, applyCoupon and orderTotal in src/pricing.js, through their return values
outOfScope: formatPrice and the 2 mutants no test reaches (missing coverage, not this run's)
Restructuring the existing tests beyond adding assertions
assumptions: README and doc comments state the intended behaviour; they agree with each other

risks.description: Boundary values (exactly $50, exactly $100) are untested, so off-by-one changes to the rules would ship unnoticed

acceptanceCriteria.text: Shipping is free for a subtotal of exactly $50 (and above), $4.99 below
SAVE20 takes 20% off only a subtotal over $100; at exactly $100 or below it changes nothing
No coupon, or a code other than SAVE20, leaves the subtotal unchanged even over $100
The order total adds shipping to the discounted subtotal

testCases.title: ships an order of exactly $50 for free
handles an order without a coupon
testCases.rationale: Kills mutants 1 (condition → true) and 2 (&& → ||): the uncouponed large order would be discounted.

testCases.title: leaves a large order unchanged with a code other than SAVE20
testCases.rationale: Kills mutants 1 and 2 for a wrong code, not just a missing one.

testCases.title: handles a small order with the coupon
does not discount an order of exactly $100 with SAVE20
adds shipping to a small order's total
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 6 (+ shipping → - shipping); the existing total case has free shipping so + and - agree.

strategy.environmentNotes: None; pure functions, run with npm test (vitest).
